caption: The drawing depicts three main objects, prominently illustrated in shades of brown and yellow. The largest object is a crescent-shaped ornament, possibly a necklace or collar, with a smooth brown surface outlined in yellow. This object also features a central segment with a series of regularly spaced, bead-like elements connected by a curved bar, and two rounded terminals on each end with circular detailing, both shaded in brown and yellow. Above this large ornament, there is a smaller circular object resembling a hoop or earring, also brown with yellow highlights. The small hoop is depicted with two spherical ends at the top. In the top left and right corners of the drawing, there are minimal, sketch-like line drawings that appear to be simplified, close-up illustrations of the mechanism or detail from the main objects, drawn in thin black lines on the beige background. The overall composition is centrally aligned with ample blank space around the objects on a cream or off-white paper.
title: Loop Earrings
